method: web.run searched official GNU manuals and opened the official coreutils GitHub v9.7 source/manual; no secondary source used for expectations. Archive/source authentication is inherited from the immutable original freeze and rechecked locally, not a new signature verification or executable rebuild.

sources.scope: Uses POSIX_BASIC with two flag removals; compile then anchored re_match at byte zero; newline_anchor disabled. Syntactic re_nsub chooses capture versus numeric return; first register may be unmatched. No-match preserves result kind. Multibyte length conversion follows matched byte offset. This informs expected categories; exact case outputs come from native capture.

sources.version: tag v9.7; local authenticated release archive manual member hash recorded in oracle receipt
sources.scope: Version-pinned expr string-expression documentation and operator examples. No copied source or regex engine is added to product.

sources.scope: Anchored BRE, first syntactic subexpression, no-capture character length, failed or nonparticipating capture, GNU escaped repetition/alternation. Corroborating documentation only; does not override pinned source/native output.

sources.observedVersionLabel: GNU Coreutils 9.10 in search; moving page
sources.scope: Literal token boundaries and exit status convention. The native harness uses argv, not shell quoting or eval.
Existing original freeze authenticated official HTTPS archive and source; this review hashes local archive and verifies its expr.c member. No new download/install is required.

retrievalLimits: Follow-up web.run lookup of gnulib BRE and grep backreference pages failed; no expectation relies on those missing pages.
General POSIX subexpression tie-breaking is not inferred from JavaScript semantics. Only explicit bounded native cases are frozen; unproven generalities stay OPEN.
